name: AVAL
role: Compiles RGBA PNG frames or video into packed-alpha .avl files for a stateful web player
summary: `avl` (npm @pixel-point/aval-compiler) turns a motion.json project and a ProRes 4444, MP4 or RGBA PNG-sequence source into one .avl per codec (AV1, VP9, H.265, H.264) with packed alpha, looping body units, named states and transitions, plus a build.json with SRI hashes and ready-made <source> markup. The <aval-player> element plays them through WebCodecs in the browser. The compiler shells out to caller-installed ffmpeg.
use_when: A VCR-rendered raster master must ship to a web page as a looping or stateful element with transparency
Hover or click state changes need prerendered video, not vector animation
One alpha-capable file per codec is wanted, with SRI hashes in a build report
avoid_when: Vector animation playback: lottie-web or dotlottie
A plain video file for delivery: ffmpeg-ffprobe
Needing AV1 output on a machine whose ffmpeg lacks libaom-av1
notes: 2026-11-27: lead said `pnpm dlx`; the fixture installs the compiler locally, pinned. Compiler 1.1.0 (npm, 2026-09-05), MIT, Node >=22.12; the lead's version and licence matched. The player package name was not checked; only the compiler was exercised.
2026-11-27: the compiler needs ffmpeg and ffprobe on PATH with libx264, libx265, libvpx-vp9 and libaom-av1 for the codecs requested. This machine's ffmpeg has no libaom-av1, so AV1 was not tried.
2026-11-27: the compiler warns when a loop's last frame jumps to its first (RMS threshold); a source that does not close its loop gets WARNING idle.body loop needs visual review.

assessment.rationale: MIT, one maintainer organisation, repository created 2026-07-13 with 4 compiler versions and 1.4k stars: young, so the format may still move (wire format 1.1). It fills a gap the vector players do not: delivering a VCR raster render as a stateful web element with packed alpha. Keep as candidate; only the compiler is evidenced, not the browser player.

evidence.result: 30 owned 128x128 RGBA PNG frames compiled to vp9.avl, h265.avl and h264.avl (7 to 11 kB each). Manifests: layout packed-alpha, stacked alpha rect, coded 128x264, 30 frames; build.json warnings empty. Two compiles byte-identical. alpha opaque refused with ALPHA_POLICY_REJECTED. Node 22.19.0, ffmpeg from Homebrew.
evidence.scope: Compiler 1.1.0 packed-alpha output for VP9, H.265, H.264 on macOS arm64; manifests parsed, not decoded. No browser player, AV1, state edges or video sources.
